description: This Java source file defines a Spring MVC web controller named PaymentsController responsible for handling HTTP requests related to payment methods management in an admin interface. It provides endpoints for viewing, configuring, saving, and deleting payment modules, with security annotations and dependency injections, and manages interactions with payment services and configuration models.

classes.name: PaymentsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller for managing payment configurations in the admin backend, including viewing available and configured payment methods, editing specific payment method settings, saving configurations, and deleting payment modules.

methods.name: getPaymentMethods
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve and display all available payment methods and their configurations for a merchant store.

methods.name: displayPaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the configuration page for a specific payment method identified by a code.

methods.name: savePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to save updates to a payment method's configuration.

methods.name: deletePaymentMethod
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specific payment method configuration.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Private helper method to set the current menu context in the model for UI navigation.
